name: Steel Vengeance
description: The most critically acclaimed and awarded roller coaster in the world — Steel Vengeance is a record-breaking hybrid wooden-steel coaster at Cedar Point delivering 27.2 seconds of airtime, four inversions and the most intense and relentless coaster experience ever built. Converted from Mean Streak in 2018, Steel Vengeance is the undisputed greatest coaster at the Roller Coaster Capital of the World. Min 122cm.

name: Millennium Force
description: The coaster that redefined the industry — Millennium Force was the world's first giga coaster when it opened in 2000, soaring 94 metres above Lake Erie before plunging riders down a stunning 80-degree drop at 150 km/h through a spectacular lakeside layout. The most beloved and iconic coaster at Cedar Point and a landmark in roller coaster history. Min 137cm.

name: Top Thrill 2
description: The most intense launch coaster in the world — Top Thrill 2 is Cedar Point's legendary 120-metre dragster coaster completely reimagined with a new triple-launch system reaching 195 km/h and an extraordinary new second spike element. The tallest and fastest accelerator coaster in the world. Min 130cm.

name: Maverick
description: The most relentlessly thrilling mid-size coaster at Cedar Point — Maverick packs a 95-degree beyond-vertical first drop, a hydraulic launch to 84 km/h, multiple inversions and extraordinary terrain-hugging speed into a compact and ferocious layout that delivers one of the most intense ride experiences at any theme park in the world. Min 122cm.

name: Valravn
description: The world's tallest, fastest and longest dive coaster — Valravn holds three world records with a 68-metre tower, a 90-degree vertical drop at 145 km/h and three inversions in a spectacular lakeside setting. The most technically impressive dive coaster ever built. Min 137cm.

name: Raptor
description: One of the greatest and most beloved inverted coasters ever built — Raptor at Cedar Point is a legendary B&M inverted coaster delivering six inversions at 121 km/h through an extraordinary layout over the midway. One of the most rerideable and acclaimed coasters in the world since 1994. Min 137cm.

name: GateKeeper
description: The world's fastest, tallest and longest wing coaster — GateKeeper soars over the main entrance of Cedar Point on wing rider vehicles with seats extending far to either side through a spectacular layout of dives, rolls and keyholes over the park gates. Min 122cm.

name: Magnum XL-200
description: The coaster that started the hypercoaster revolution — Magnum XL-200 was the world's first coaster to break the 200-foot barrier when it opened in 1989 and changed the roller coaster industry forever. A Cedar Point icon and beloved classic delivering extraordinary airtime over Lake Erie. Min 122cm.

name: Rougarou
description: A thrilling floorless roller coaster at Cedar Point delivering multiple inversions in an open floorless vehicle — Rougarou is one of the most popular and accessible thrill coasters at the park. Min 137cm.

name: Gemini
description: A beloved racing dual-track coaster at Cedar Point and one of the most iconic and nostalgic attractions at the park — Gemini has been racing its twin trains since 1978 and remains one of the most fun and rerideable coasters in the world. Min 122cm.

name: Iron Dragon
description: A classic and beloved suspended swinging coaster at Cedar Point weaving through trees and over a lagoon — Iron Dragon is one of the most charming and accessible family thrill coasters at Cedar Point. Min 107cm.

name: Corkscrew
description: A beloved Cedar Point classic and one of the first coasters to feature a corkscrew inversion — the Corkscrew has delivered classic loop-and-twist thrills since 1976 and is one of the most historically significant attractions at the Roller Coaster Capital of the World. Min 122cm.

name: Cedar Creek Mine Ride
description: A classic and charming mine train coaster at Cedar Point weaving through the landscape over the lagoon — Cedar Creek Mine Ride is one of the most beloved and accessible family coasters at Cedar Point and a park institution since 1969. Min 107cm.

name: WindSeeker
description: A spectacular 91-metre swing tower at Cedar Point spinning riders high above the Lake Erie shoreline for extraordinary panoramic views over the park, the lake and the Ohio coastline. Suitable for all ages.
